overview_description.description: Zenamins is a comprehensive online vitamin subscription service that is personalized and designed specifically with the individual in mind. Zenamins was designed to make vitamin-taking easier, safer and more convenient. Simply select the vitamins, minerals and supplements you want or use the special online guide to determine which ones are best for you. Every four weeks subscribers receive a new Zenamins pack in the post. Zenamins uses pharmacy-grade technology to custom pack vitamins into daily doses, while all vitamins and supplements are of the highest quality and mostly softgels, as these have shown to have 4x the absorption.

about_short_description.short_description: Zenamins is a subscription service that home delivers a monthly box of preferred vitamins to its subscribers.

product.name: Personalized Vitamin Packs Subscription
product.description: A subscription service delivering custom daily vitamin packs tailored to individual preferences and health needs every four weeks.

product.name: Multivitamin Softgels
product.description: Softgel multivitamins formulated for different demographics including men, women, prenatal, postnatal, and age-specific groups.

product.name: Omega Oils Softgels
product.description: Softgel supplements containing Omega 3, 6, and 9 fatty acids from sources like fish oil, flaxseed oil, and krill oil.

product.name: Specific Vitamins Softgels and Tablets
product.description: Individual vitamin supplements available in softgel or tablet form, including vitamins A, B-complex, C, D3, E, K2, and others.

product.name: Mineral Supplements
product.description: Mineral supplements including calcium, magnesium, selenium, iron, potassium gluconate, and zinc in softgel or tablet form.

product.name: Co-enzyme Supplements
product.description: Supplements containing co-enzymes like Ubiquinol and CoQ10 in various dosages to support cellular energy and heart health.
